engine_basis: Zend/zend_exceptions.c::Exception::__toString writes the formatted result to the private string slot; its _build_trace_args helper renders array arguments as the same `Array, ` placeholder without reading their elements.

Zend/zend_object_handlers.c::zend_std_compare_objects compares distinct same-class builtin objects through initialized physical slots. The string cache precedes the trace slot, so equal cache text can expose later trace differences.
Zend/zend_hash.c::zend_hash_compare_impl compares array counts, then keys and values; a missing key returns +1 in either orientation.
